def has_matching_key(env): return env.carrying is not None and env.carrying.type == "key"


def target_door_open(env): return any(c is not None and c.type == "door" and c.is_open for y in range(5 * (max([y for x in range(env.width) for y in range(env.height) for c in [env.grid.get(x, y)] if c is not None and c.type == "ball"], default=env.agent_pos[1]) // 5), 5 * (max([y for x in range(env.width) for y in range(env.height) for c in [env.grid.get(x, y)] if c is not None and c.type == "ball"], default=env.agent_pos[1]) // 5) + 6) for c in [env.grid.get(env.width - 6, y)])
